<?php
/**
 * IoT Device Firmware Update Manager
 * Handles OTA updates with rate limiting and retry logic
 * Version 2.4.1
 */

class RateLimiter {
    private $maxRequests;
    private $windowSeconds;
    private $storePath;

    public function __construct(int $maxRequests = 5, int $windowSeconds = 60) {
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
        $this->storePath = '/tmp/iot_rate_limits.json';
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $clientId): bool {
        $limits = $this->loadLimits();
        $now = time();
        $windowStart = $now - $this->windowSeconds;

        if (!isset($limits[$clientId])) {
            $limits[$clientId] = [];
        }

        $limits[$clientId] = array_filter(
            $limits[$clientId],
            fn($ts) => $ts > $windowStart
        );

        if (count($limits[$clientId]) >= $this->maxRequests) {
            return false;
        }

        $limits[$clientId][] = $now;
        $this->saveLimits($limits);
        return true;
    }

    private function loadLimits(): array {
        if (!file_exists($this->storePath)) return [];
        return json_decode(file_get_contents($this->storePath), true) ?? [];
    }

    private function saveLimits(array $limits): void {
        file_put_contents($this->storePath, json_encode($limits), LOCK_EX);
    }
}

class FirmwareUpdateClient {
    private const ALLOWED_HOSTS = [
        'firmware.iot-vendor.com',
        'updates.iot-vendor.com',
        'cdn.iot-vendor.com'
    ];

    private const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
    private const RETRY_DELAY_MS = 500;

    private RateLimiter $rateLimiter;
    private string $deviceId;
    private array $resolverCache = [];

    public function __construct(string $deviceId) {
        $this->deviceId = $deviceId;
        $this->rateLimiter = new RateLimiter(10, 300);
    }

    public function checkForUpdate(string $channel = 'stable'): ?array {
        $manifestUrl = $this->buildManifestUrl($channel);
        if ($manifestUrl === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $response = $this->fetchWithRetry($manifestUrl);
        if ($response === null) return null;

        $manifest = json_decode($response, true);
        if (!$this->validateManifest($manifest)) return null;

        return $manifest;
    }

    public function downloadFirmware(string $url, string $expectedHash): ?string {
        if (!$this->isUrlAllowed($url)) {
            error_log("Blocked firmware URL: $url");
            return null;
        }

        $data = $this->fetchWithRetry($url);
        if ($data === null) return null;

        if (hash('sha256', $data) !== $expectedHash) {
            error_log("Firmware hash mismatch");
            return null;
        }

        return $data;
    }

    private function buildManifestUrl(string $channel): ?string {
        $allowedChannels = ['stable', 'beta', 'nightly'];
        if (!in_array($channel, $allowedChannels, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        return "https://firmware.iot-vendor.com/v2/manifest/{$channel}/{$this->deviceId}.json";
    }

    private function isUrlAllowed(string $url): bool {
        $parsed = parse_url($url);
        if ($parsed === false || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!isset($parsed['scheme']) || $parsed['scheme'] !== 'https') {
            return false;
        }

        $host = strtolower($parsed['host']);
        return $this->isHostAuthorized($host);
    }

    private function isHostAuthorized(string $host): bool {
        foreach (self::ALLOWED_HOSTS as $allowed) {
            if ($host === $allowed || str_ends_with($host, '.' . $allowed)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function resolveAndValidate(string $url): ?string {
        $parsed = parse_url($url);
        $host = $parsed['host'];

        // Always resolve fresh - no caching to prevent DNS rebinding
        $resolved = gethostbyname($host);

        $ip = $resolved;

        // Validate resolved IP is not internal
        if ($this->isInternalIp($ip)) {
            error_log("DNS rebinding protection: $host resolved to internal IP $ip");
            return null;
        }

        return $url;
    }

    private function isInternalIp(string $ip): bool {
        if (!filter_var($ip, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) {
            return true; // treat invalid as internal
        }

        $privateRanges = [
            ['0.0.0.0', '0.255.255.255'],
            ['10.0.0.0', '10.255.255.255'],
            ['127.0.0.0', '127.255.255.255'],
            ['169.254.0.0', '169.254.255.255'], // link-local incl. cloud metadata
            ['172.16.0.0', '172.31.255.255'],
            ['192.168.0.0', '192.168.255.255'],
        ];

        $ipLong = ip2long($ip);
        foreach ($privateRanges as [$start, $end]) {
            if ($ipLong >= ip2long($start) && $ipLong <= ip2long($end)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function fetchWithRetry(string $url): ?string {
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->isAllowed($this->deviceId)) {
            error_log("Rate limit exceeded for device: {$this->deviceId}");
            return null;
        }

        for ($attempt = 0; $attempt < self::MAX_RETRIES; $attempt++) {
            if ($attempt > 0) {
                usleep(self::RETRY_DELAY_MS * 1000 * $attempt);
            }

            // Validate URL on EVERY attempt to prevent DNS rebinding
            $validatedUrl = $this->resolveAndValidate($url);
            if ($validatedUrl === null) {
                return null;
            }

            $result = $this->doFetch($url);
            if ($result !== null) {
                return $result;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function doFetch(string $url): ?string {
        $ctx = stream_context_create([
            'http' => [
                'timeout' => 10,
                'follow_location' => 0,
                'max_redirects' => 0,
                'method' => 'GET',
                'header' => "User-Agent: IoTFirmwareUpdater/2.4.1\r\n"
            ],
            'ssl' => [
                'verify_peer' => true,
                'verify_peer_name' => true,
            ]
        ]);

        $response = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
        if ($response === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return $response;
    }

    private function validateManifest(?array $manifest): bool {
        if ($manifest === null) return false;
        $required = ['version', 'firmware_url', 'sha256', 'released_at'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($manifest[$field])) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

// Entry point for firmware check API
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');

    $deviceId = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_DEVICE_ID'] ?? null;
    $channel = $_GET['channel'] ?? 'stable';

    if (!$deviceId || !preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{16}$/', $deviceId)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid device ID']);
        exit;
    }

    $client = new FirmwareUpdateClient($deviceId);
    $update = $client->checkForUpdate($channel);

    if ($update) {
        echo json_encode(['update_available' => true, 'manifest' => $update]);
    } else {
        echo json_encode(['update_available' => false]);
    }
}
